title: Align version_is_newer in rust/dodag.rs + python/dodag.py with routing.rs serial-arithmetic lollipop (C now matches routing.rs)
description: C comparators were ported verbatim from rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs:63-89 (mod-128 directional diff same-region, RFC 7.2 rule-3 cross-region) with exhaustive 65536-pair sweep proving C==Rust-routing. But rust/dodag.rs and python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py version_is_newer still use the old |diff|<=WINDOW formulation and their unit tests assert it — they now diverge from both C and routing.rs on multi-step wraps (e.g. incoming=5 vs current=120). Repo rule: identical output across implementations. Align both to routing.rs formulation, recompute affected unit-test expectations from routing.rs (not from current dodag code), extend shared wrap-boundary vectors (127->0 multi-step, 255->0, +-17 past wrap).
